messages:
marie_docs: Quick heads up — PR #4621 needs final reviewers. It's the migration guide + SDK Python snippet sync. CI preview flagged link-lint and a few tone nits. Can we get eyes? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621

sam_devex: On it :eyes: I'll take the SDK snippets and example parity. @liam_eng could you do a terminology/voice pass?

liam_eng: Yep, assigning myself. Noted one phrasing issue: 'model owner' -> prefer 'model maintainers' per style guide. Also some code blocks lack language hint (use ```python).

zara_pm: For customer wording, prefer 'predictable throughput' over 'predictable perf' — keep it explicit for product copy.

ci-bot: Docs preview build #724 failed — link-lint error: /guides/migration#pinning anchor not found.

marie_docs: Thanks — I'll remove the bad anchor and push a quick fix. Quick Q: do we standardize on f-strings in SDK snippets or use .format() for older compatibility?

sam_devex: f-strings are fine (we support py3.8+). Keep consistent with other snippets and add an async example if possible.

liam_eng: +1 for f-strings. Voice pass: switch a few instances of 'you' to 'your application' and collapse passive sentences. I'll paste line numbers in comments.

marie_docs: Pushed fix (removed anchor, tightened wording, fixed snippet). Added a reviewer checklist in PR body: 'style/terminology/CI preview green'. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621/files

sam_devex: Reviewed — left two tiny nits (link formatting and a sentence fragment). LGTM after those.

liam_eng: Approved; left a comment for the 'model owner' -> 'model maintainers' change on line 245.

marie_docs: Addressed both nits and rebased. CI preview running.

ci-bot: Docs preview build #725 passed :white_check_mark:.

marie_docs: Planning to merge during docs deploy window tomorrow 09:00 PT unless any objections. Added changelog note and internal release note for Dedicated customers.

zara_pm: Ack — added ops notify for the Dedicated channel.

marie_docs: Merged. Thanks all :tada:
